name: e-learning-platform
description: A modern e-learning platform with React and Node.js featuring user authentication, course management, and professional UI/UX design

scripts.start: concurrently "cd lms/backend && npm start" "cd lms/frontend && npm start"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd lms/backend && npm run dev" "cd lms/frontend && npm start"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd lms/frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm start to begin development.'

author: Ajit Kumar
